learner_identified: read_inertia obtains estimated location/altitude through AHRS
AP_MotorsMulticopter output invokes AP_MotorsMatrix mixing for individual motor demands
clarifications: MAVProxy sends requests; it does not estimate height or run flight controllers.
AHRS is an internal estimator interface, not an outside sensor.
read_inertia/update_estimates read estimated state; D_update_controller uses it for feedback control.
Both estimator and controller/motor paths execute within native ArduPilot C++; simulated or physical sensor observations are inputs.

No new independent flight or physical-hardware verification.
Full estimator/sensor implementation, waypoint routing and LAND internals are outside this one-command slice.
